en.tip: In Portuguese we say “dinheiro suficiente”, with the word after; in English, “enough” comes first: “enough money”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I do not have money enough.” The right way is “I do not have enough money.” In Portuguese we say “dinheiro suficiente”, with the word after; in English, “enough” comes first: “enough money”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
